mainReview.qualification: Only trainathome.ai is classified as a verified direct competitor here. Other entries are operator dashboards, official documentation, or unverified shells; not 24 independent competitors. Search terms are inferred user questions, not Search Console rankings or measured AI citations.
appliedPatterns: Separate address, worker, payment, and period fields
Explicit illustrative examples rather than invented measurements
Link diagnosis to correct project tool and related guides
limitations: No fee/income forecasts copied from calculators
Title-only pages cannot substantiate product capabilities
Dated tier maps from third parties are not official promotion rules
